packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major updates. Majors stay manual.
@types/node tracks the supported Node range, so bumps are a deliberate call.
@types/glob >=9 and @types/rimraf >=4 are deprecated stubs; glob/rimraf ship their own types. Lift when glob/rimraf themselves are upgraded.
chalk v6 requires Node >=22 but this published package supports Node >=20. Lift when the engines floor is raised.
execa v10 requires Node >=22 but this published package supports Node >=20. Lift when the engines floor is raised.
